parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Sends a check request without querying instance information. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether the instance status is valid. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, `DryRunOperation` is returned.

false (default): Sends a normal request. After the request passes the check, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会查询实例信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、实例状态。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

ISP.description_en:
The line type. Valid values:
BGP: BGP (multi-ISP) line. All regions support BGP (multi-ISP) lines.
BGP_PRO: BGP (multi-ISP) premium line. Currently, only the Hong Kong (China), Singapore, Japan (Tokyo), Philippines (Manila), Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur), Indonesia (Jakarta), and Thailand (Bangkok) regions support BGP (multi-ISP) premium Internet Shared Bandwidth instances.

If you are a whitelist user of single-ISP bandwidth, the following types may also be returned:

ChinaTelecom: China Telecom
ChinaUnicom: China Unicom   
ChinaMobile: China Mobile
ChinaTelecom_L2: China Telecom L2
ChinaUnicom_L2: China Unicom L2
ChinaMobile_L2: China Mobile L2

If you are a Finance Cloud user in the China (Hangzhou) region, BGP_FinanceCloud is returned
ISP.description_zh:
线路类型。
BGP：BGP（多线）线路。目前全部地域都支持BGP（多线）线路。
BGP_PRO：BGP（多线）_精品线路。目前仅中国香港、新加坡、日本（东京）、菲律宾（马尼拉）、马来西亚（吉隆坡）、印度尼西亚（雅加达）和泰国（曼谷）地域支持BGP（多线）_精品线路共享带宽。

如果您是单线带宽的白名单用户，返回类型还可能为：

ChinaTelecom：中国电信
ChinaUnicom：中国联通   
ChinaMobile：中国移动
ChinaTelecom_L2：中国电信L2
ChinaUnicom_L2：中国联通L2
ChinaMobile_L2：中国移动L2

如果您是杭州金融云用户，返回BGP_FinanceCloud
